## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Consumer and architecture impact

State whether package mode, copy mode, public exports, registry metadata, tokens, or docs routes change. Link migration guidance for breaking changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated where needed
- [ ] Packed external consumer checked if exports, CSS paths, registry, CLI, or install instructions changed
- [ ] Docs updated if public behavior changed
- [ ] Changeset added for user-facing package changes
- [ ] No secrets or private credentials introduced
- [ ] No breaking changes without explicit note and migration guidance

## Validation

List the commands or checks used to validate the change.
